title.narrative: Quality management activities for humanitarian demining in Colombia

description.narrative:
Continue to provide confidence to national authorities, demining organizations, local authorities and mine-affected communities regarding the demining procedures, processes and capacities of humanitarian demining organizations.
The expected effect(s) for the target group of the Project (Outcome) are: 1. External monitoring of demining in Colombia is conducted using a revised, more cost efficient and sustainable model in support of a transition to national ownership. 2. Demining organizations are able to conduct land release operations in a safe, effective and efficient way. 3. Demining organizations conduct operations to enable affected communities to safely use released land.
The main planned products and/or services of the Project (Outputs) are: - Output 1.1: A revised model for external monitoring of demining operations is developed and implemented. - Output 2.1: Standard Operational Procedures (SOP) evaluated are compliant with national mine action standards. - Output 2.2: Prospective surveyors, deminers, leaders and specialized teams are able to conduct operations as per approved SOPs. - Output 3.1: NTS is conducted applying all reasonable efforts to identify evidence of explosive ordnance contamination. - Output 3.2: Clearance operations are conducted in a safe, effective and efficient manner. - Output 3.3: All presence of explosive ordnance in hazardous areas is eliminated.
